ct-w01-a01.rationale: The open paper planner reinforces that balances must be interpreted alongside dated commitments. It contains no person, bank branding, currency or account information.
ct-w01-a01.altText: Open paper planner beside pink flowers and a glass jar on a white desk, representing bills and dates to consider before payday.
ct-w01-a01.caption: Planning bills by date helps turn a current balance into a forward-looking estimate.

ct-w01-b01.rationale: The blank-screen phone, notebook and pen support deliberate manual entry without depicting a bank interface, personal data or a distressed customer.
ct-w01-b01.altText: Black smartphone with its screen turned off resting on a notebook beside a fountain pen in a tan leather bag.
ct-w01-b01.caption: A manual money app can work from figures you choose to enter without importing a bank transaction history.
